dict.string: MIT licence. The sample packs and listening models it downloads have their own.
Claudius listens to your microphone or audio interface while its Record window is open, to show the input's level and record takes, and at no other time.
Claudius opens the recordings and songs that you or your assistant name in your Downloads folder, to add, sample or open them, and saves there only what you choose to.
Claudius opens the recordings and songs that you or your assistant name on your Desktop, to add, sample or open them, and saves there only what you choose to.
Claudius opens the recordings and songs that you or your assistant name in your Documents folder, to add, sample or open them, and saves there only what you choose to.
Claudius opens the recordings, songs and sample packs that you or your assistant name on a drive you plug in, and saves there only what you choose to.
Claudius opens the recordings, songs and sample packs that you or your assistant name on a network drive, and saves there only what you choose to.
